description: KernSpark brings consistency to Spring Boot applications through a standardized DataEnvelope response wrapper, a rich exception hierarchy with HTTP status mapping, generic validation primitives, and reusable utilities—all with zero runtime dependencies beyond Spring Boot. Designed to complement the Spring ecosystem, not replace it, KernSpark eliminates the need for every team to reinvent common backend patterns, providing a well-tested open-source foundation for production-ready microservices and APIs.
